findings.title: Recheck the cache after acquiring the write lock
findings.body: A caller that observed an empty cache before waiting for this lock never checks it again after acquiring the lock. During a cold-start burst, each queued non-Dev caller therefore reloads and parses the manifest and overwrites the cache in turn, delaying all waiting requests with redundant serialized work. Recheck `entryPointAssetsCache` under the lock and return it when populated before loading again.
